coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Fuel marking (molecular markers) mandatory since 1 Oct 2024, unmarked fuel banned from 1 Jan 2025; AZS must run automated control tied to online cash registers (deadline 2020) and send monthly stock/shipment/pump-counter data to the tax service. State-driven and vendor-supplied, no small-operator gap seen. LPG: March 2026 proposal for cylinder inspection every 3 years (refusal of refuelling without certificate), temporary regime to 31 Dec 2026; Decree 508 of 24 Jul 2026 on vehicle conversion/GBO; illegal gas stations in Sokuluk (June 2026). Candidates C03, C09.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Only April 2026 draft to extend 0% VAT on wheat between mills, plus rail import bottleneck via Kazakhstan; flour fortification rules are old (2009). No filing duty for small millers found. Weak candidate C10.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Only found that NBKR counts 69 credit unions, falling in number (tazabek). No reporting rules found; article body not opened. Nothing usable.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Ministry of Health suspended 263 private clinics (24.kg); 2025 inspections found 147 of 311 clinics without permits; bill would require licence-bound practice, patient contracts and published price lists; private clinics being connected to the e-sick-leave module of the state MIS via public offer (UNDP, July 2025 pilot). Cloud MIS Medesk already used by Prime Clinic. Candidate C02.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K09 (traceability). Narcotics/precursor law exists, 2025 law No. 56 on precursors and youth, Cabinet proposed 1-year control of potent substances (24.kg); the 2005 Health Ministry order on narcotics storage and accounting is void and no current Kyrgyz pharmacy journal rule was found. Unverifiable from the searches.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Search returned no Kyrgyz source on private security licensing (only RU/KZ/GE pages). Overseas-employment agency licensing bill published 7 Oct 2026 (Minsotstrud) is the manpower hit: see K04. Security and cleaning not verified.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Construction licences are issued online via license.minstroy.kg (fees now 150k-1.5m som by category; certified specialist team must be added in the system; 249 licences revoked in H1 2025; blacklist with 90 days to cure; Dec 2025 bill to let the ministry annul licences). Subsoil: 1,981 licences inventoried in May 2026, 836 violations, about 25% suspended or annulled (reclamation account notices, bonuses, expired terms). Candidates C01, C09.
